1. **Discovery & Translational Science**

**Deletion of P311 enhances muscle regeneration in aging** [npj Aging](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41514-026-00451-0)
- Targeted deletion of P311 was shown to enhance skeletal muscle regenerative capacity in aged animal models.
- Results position P311 pathway modulation as a novel target for addressing age-related sarcopenia and muscle degeneration.

**Epithelial-derived epigenetic clock unveils pathways in chronic lung disease** [npj Aging](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41514-026-00487-2)
- Researchers established a novel epithelial cell-derived epigenetic clock to measure biological aging within human lung tissue.
- The biomarker framework isolates specific pathway-level aging mechanisms driving chronic respiratory diseases.

**Whole-genome sequencing characterizes novel locus in congenital kidney malformations** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.1101/2024.10.10.24315242)
- Whole-genome sequencing of 1,052 individuals with congenital anomalies of the kidneys and urinary tract (CAKUT) achieved an overall diagnostic yield of 4.9% for monogenic variants, rising to 11.1% in cystic kidney dysplasia.
- Association testing identified a novel genome-wide significant locus at 6q16.3 (rs117473527; OR = 3.13, 95% CI 2.08–4.72, p = 4.8×10⁻⁸).

**Variational disease progression score framework maps Alzheimer's biomarker sequence** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.19.26360855)
- A machine learning model integrating baseline CSF, neuroimaging, and cognitive metrics inferred subject-specific Alzheimer's progression timelines with 89%–98% empirical coverage in 95% credible intervals.
- The framework accurately separated cognitively normal individuals from Alzheimer's disease cases with an AUC of 0.98 in the ADNI cohort without prior diagnostic supervision.

**Nektar's rezpegaldesleukin Treg strategy supported by published findings** [X / @tejada444](https://x.com/tejada444/status/2091282235181953366)
- Published data in *The Lancet* provide support for the T-regulatory (Treg) cell-targeting strategy of rezpegaldesleukin (rezpeg).

2. **Early Trials — Phase I–II**

**Psilocybin demonstrates distinct brain network connectivity response in autistic adults** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.19.26360794)
- The double-blind, cross-over PSILAUT trial evaluated low-dose oral psilocybin (2 mg or 5 mg) versus placebo in matched autistic and non-autistic adults.
- Resting-state fMRI demonstrated differential large-scale functional network connectivity shifts in the autistic brain following low-dose psilocybin administration.

**Pharmacokinetics and dialyzability of HRS-9231 defined in renal impairment** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42631820/)
- A Phase 1 clinical pharmacokinetic study characterized the elimination, clearance rates, and dialyzability of HRS-9231 across subjects with varying degrees of renal impairment.

**Phase 2 trial identifies prognostic biomarkers in pediatric T-cell lymphoblastic lymphoma** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42631900/)
- A prospective, multicenter, single-arm Phase 2 trial evaluated clinical and molecular risk factors in newly diagnosed pediatric T-LBL.
- The trial identified baseline genomic and clinical markers associated with disease outcomes to inform future risk-stratified therapy protocols.

3. **Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III**

**[Big Pharma]** **Merck and Moderna personalized cancer vaccine meets Phase 3 primary endpoint** [X / @adamfeuerstein](https://x.com/adamfeuerstein/status/2091282235181953366)
- **[Big Pharma] Merck** and **[Biotech] Moderna** reported positive top-line Phase 3 trial results evaluating their personalized mRNA cancer vaccine (mRNA-4157/V940) combined with Keytruda in resected melanoma.
- The combination study met its primary endpoint; detailed efficacy and safety data readouts remain pending.

5. **Business & Strategy**

**[Big Pharma]** **Bristol Myers Squibb acquires NVIDIA compute cluster to accelerate AI drug discovery** [X / @PearlF](https://x.com/PearlF/status/2091282235181953366)
- **[Big Pharma] Bristol Myers Squibb** purchased an NVIDIA Vera Rubin SuperPOD infrastructure to expand its computational capabilities.
- The company aims to leverage the system to compress internal drug development timelines by 20%–30%.

**[Biotech]** **Werewolf Therapeutics merges with Ambros Therapeutics alongside $150M financing** [X / @BioStocks](https://x.com/BioStocks/status/2091282235181953366)
- **[Biotech] Werewolf Therapeutics** announced a definitive merger agreement with Ambros Therapeutics.
- The transaction is supported by an oversubscribed $150 million private placement financing.

**[Biotech]** **Hims & Hers CEO responds to FTC legal action amid GLP-1 price projections** [X / @AIStockSavvy](https://x.com/AIStockSavvy/status/2091282235181953366)
- **[Biotech] Hims & Hers** leadership addressed an FTC legal challenge regarding company practices.
- The CEO projected that market forces and compounding scaling could drive monthly GLP-1 consumer prices down to $40–$50.

6. **Public Health & Policy**

**Sub-national modeling highlights divergent Bundibugyo virus trajectories in DRC** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.19.26360792)
- Hierarchical Bayesian renewal modeling of the 2026 Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the DRC showed that national reproduction numbers (Rt ~ 1.0) mask ongoing active transmission in Haut-Uele (Rt = 1.79) and Nord-Kivu (Rt = 1.23).
- Spatial disaggregation in Ituri province indicated that original epicenter Mongbwalu has declined (Rt = 0.36), while main urban centers (Bunia, Rwampara) remain at or above the epidemic threshold.

**Delivery cost benchmarked for Typhoid Conjugate Vaccine campaigns in Ghana and DRC** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.12.26360337)
- An economic analysis of TCV catch-up campaigns across 54,814 children established the financial cost per fully immunized person at $5.78 in Ghana and $5.47 in the DRC.
- Direct vaccine procurement and administration supplies formed the majority of costs, totaling $2.76 per person in Ghana and $2.39 in the DRC.

**Programmatic food support linked to lower mortality in West African tuberculosis care** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.08.19.26360811)
- A prospective natural experiment across 13 West African sites compared drug-susceptible TB patients receiving routine in-kind food support in Benin against unassisted controls in Togo.
- Programmatic food support was associated with lower mortality (aOR = 0.32, 95% CI 0.11–0.93), increased treatment adherence (aOR = 3.43), and higher odds of ≥5% weight gain at two months (aOR = 1.57).

- Economics
    - [How Much Would an AI Crash Destroy?](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wTiYaWFP59Q) -- Patrick Boyle
        - Extreme market concentration is demonstrated by two chip stocks driving 17% of global stock market returns in a single month, leaving average investors heavily exposed.
        - Wealth destruction estimates from economists Dean Baker, Gita Gopinath, and consultancy Oliver Wyman suggest a potential AI market crash could destroy tens of trillions of dollars.
        - Conventional diversification hedges—including small caps, value funds, and international equities—are increasingly populated by AI-linked stocks, creating a false sense of security.
        - Historical analyses by the Bank for International Settlements comparing current AI buildout to the railway and dot-com bubbles show that a technology being genuinely transformative does not protect investors who overpay for it.
